card.name: The verb call and calling
card.fires_on: The verb "call" or "calling" in general web prose, mostly right after a subject or a comma and before its object. It covers calling for something, calling attention, and calling something by a name.

modes.label: Call for or on
modes.description: A person or group urges action, with "call/calling for" or "on".
modes.example: WHO is<< calling>> on governments to take concrete actions to improve

modes.label: Call as naming or drawing
modes.description: "Call" means to name something, or to call attention or to mind.
modes.example: settlers, this irregular jumble of lakes, rivers and mountains was largely an impenetrable wilderness; even the Native Americans skirted the region,<< calling>> the few who lived in the area Rat
